scope: scripts/qualify_hardware_changes.py --slice gsd on an owned scratch with a second CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 on HwNet and an ET 200MP station that creates the IO system HwPeerIo. The project's own exported I-device GSD (GSDML V2.45, designation TiaMcpIDevice, two transfer areas), installed by an operator in TIA, is the one catalog entry found; hardware_add adds it, network_configure puts its node on HwNet without an address (the GSD reads IpProtocolSelection OtherPath), and network_io_assign assigns it to HwPeerIo with compile and save: both transfer areas take start addresses owned by the assigning PLC, everything else stays exact, the assignment restores once from its checkpoint and applies again. 52/52 steps.
limitations: One GSD device, the project's own I-device export; no modules plugged into it, no shared-device access, no other GSD vendors or device families.
V21 Openness has no GSD installation API: an operator installs the GSD in TIA before the run; without it the runner records gsdNotInstalled.

steps: search the catalog for the installed I-device GSD
prepare assign HwGsd to HwPeerCpu, restored
change_status assign HwGsd to HwPeerCpu, restored
snapshot assign HwGsd to HwPeerCpu, restored
